detail: Specification complete. Ready to implement dosage highlighting for non-standard dosages (≠1) across 6+ medication display locations in care_fe frontend. Implementation requires: (1) new utility function shouldHighlightDosage() in src/components/Medicine/utils.ts, (2) visual highlighting with WCAG 2.1 AA compliant styling (bold + border/background, not color alone), (3) updates to GroupedMedicationRow, MedicineAdminSheet, MedicineAdminForm, MedicationsTable, PrescriptionPreview, and PrintMedicationAdministration components, (4) Playwright E2E tests for medication administration with non-standard dosages.
